svg.aria-label: Arduino Projects Collection, five embedded systems projects in C and C plus plus. The signal chain runs from analog sensor input, through the microcontroller and a state machine, out to PWM and GPIO, and finally to LED and buzzer output. The five projects are Controlled LED, Disco Strobe Light, Light Dimmer, Memory Game and Plant Monitor.
